tex_content.html:
Theorem
[Relative isoperimetric inequality for the two-ball] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0071 1. ch28:28.35–28.36\group Finite Width

If $E\subset B(r)\subset \mathbb R^2$ has area at most $\frac12\pi r^2$, then $P_{\rm geo}(E,B(r))^2\ge \frac8\pi \Area (E)$. The corresponding level-set estimate is \[ \mathcal H^1(f^{-1}(c))^2\ge \frac8\pi \min \{ \mathcal H^2(f\le c),\mathcal H^2(f\ge c)\} . \]
